annotations.description: Bottoming an Island when the hand has expensive spells (Seafloor Oracle at 2UU, Merrow Reejerey at 2U) means keeping only 3 lands. Getting stuck on 3 lands would strand the 4-mana Oracle. Soul Read competes with Oracle at 4 mana and is less impactful for the Merfolk synergy gameplan.
annotations.actionTaken: Bottomed an Island, keeping 3 lands
annotations.betterLine: Bottom Soul Read instead - it's the most expendable card competing at the same mana cost as Seafloor Oracle, and Lookout's Dispersal already provides interaction. Keeping 4 lands ensures casting Oracle on curve.

annotations.description: Equipped Heirloom Blade to Triton Shorestalker instead of casting Seafloor Oracle before combat. Oracle would have drawn a card this combat via Shorestalker's unblockable combat damage trigger, while also providing a 2/3 body. The Oracle + unblockable Merfolk engine generates compounding card advantage each turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Equipped Heirloom Blade to Triton Shorestalker for +3/+1, dealing 4 unblockable damage instead of 1.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Seafloor Oracle precombat, then attack with Triton Shorestalker to deal 1 damage and draw a card from Oracle's trigger. This establishes a repeatable card advantage engine.

annotations.description: Faith's Fetters was cast targeting Heirloom Blade instead of Triton Shorestalker. Since Heirloom Blade is already equipped, Faith's Fetters only prevents the equip ability from being activated (moving it to another creature), but the +3/+1 static bonus remains on Shorestalker. The Triton Shorestalker continues as a 4/2 unblockable attacker, dealing 4 damage per turn. At 14 life, GLM47 has only ~3 more turns to live.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Heirloom Blade with Faith's Fetters
annotations.betterLine: Target Triton Shorestalker with Faith's Fetters to prevent it from attacking. This completely neutralizes the 4 unblockable damage per turn threat. The opponent would have Heirloom Blade but no relevant creature to equip it to.

annotations.description: Put the +1/+1 counter on Basri's Lieutenant instead of Tempered Veteran. Tempered Veteran with a counter becomes an engine - its cheap {W},{T} ability can then put counters on any creature that has one, creating snowballing value. Additionally, Basri's Solidarity in hand would give Basri's Lieutenant its counter anyway.
annotations.actionTaken: Put the +1/+1 counter on Basri's Lieutenant, making it a 4/5
annotations.betterLine: Put the counter on Tempered Veteran, enabling its {W},{T} ability to cheaply grow creatures each turn. Next turn, Tempered Veteran could put a counter on Basri's Lieutenant for just {W}, giving both creatures counters and the death-trigger synergy.

annotations.description: Activated Tempered Veteran's ability precombat, tapping it and preventing it from attacking. The opponent has no available blockers (Seafloor Oracle is sick, Triton Shorestalker is tapped), so Tempered Veteran could have attacked for 1 damage freely.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Tempered Veteran precombat to put a +1/+1 counter on Basri's Lieutenant (which is sick and can't attack anyway).
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Tempered Veteran and Staunch Shieldmate first (opponent has no blockers available), then activate Tempered Veteran's ability postcombat to grow Basri's Lieutenant. This would deal 1 extra damage.

annotations.description: Declined to block Staunch Shieldmate (1/3) with Seafloor Oracle (2/3) when the opponent is completely tapped out. Blocking would prevent 1 damage with zero risk since the Oracle survives combat (takes 1 damage, has 3 toughness) and the opponent has no mana for combat tricks.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose not to block, taking 1 unnecessary damage.
annotations.betterLine: Block Staunch Shieldmate with Seafloor Oracle to prevent 1 damage for free - neither creature dies and opponent has no mana for tricks.

annotations.description: All opponent creatures are tapped or have summoning sickness, so nothing can block. Seafloor Oracle could attack for free, dealing 2 extra damage and drawing an additional card (from its own Merfolk combat damage trigger). Attacking with only Triton Shorestalker leaves 2 damage and 1 card draw on the table with zero risk.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only Triton Shorestalker
annotations.betterLine: Attack with all — both Triton Shorestalker and Seafloor Oracle — to deal 6 total damage and draw 2 cards instead of 4 damage and 1 card.

annotations.description: Cast Trusty Retriever (a 2/3 or 3/4 that can't attack this turn) using nearly all mana, instead of Basri's Solidarity which would have put +1/+1 counters on all three creatures (buffing attacks and enabling Basri's Lieutenant death triggers on all of them) while leaving 3 mana open for Feat of Resistance as a combat trick or Tempered Veteran activation.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Trusty Retriever for 4 mana precombat, adding a summoning-sick body.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Basri's Solidarity for 2 mana, buffing all three creatures with +1/+1 counters (enabling Basri's Lieutenant synergy), then attack with the larger board while holding up Feat of Resistance (2 mana) as a combat trick.

annotations.description: Activating Tempered Veteran pre-combat uses the only available untapped mana (Plains), and with only 1 land drop remaining, GLM47 will have at most 1 mana after playing a land. This means Feat of Resistance ({1}{W}) cannot be cast this turn as a combat trick. The +1/+1 counter from Veteran is nice but having Feat of Resistance available for combat (granting protection from blue to push damage through or protect from removal) is likely more valuable.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Tempered Veteran's ability pre-combat, spending the only untapped Plains.
annotations.betterLine: Hold the Plains untapped, play a land drop, and keep 2 mana open for Feat of Resistance as a combat trick, which provides both a +1/+1 counter and protection from a chosen color.

annotations.description: Mistwalker is attacking with flying into no flying/reach blockers, and the opponent has all lands tapped so cannot respond with combat tricks. Activating Mistwalker's +1/-1 ability 1-2 times would deal 1-2 extra damage for free, bringing the opponent from 5 to 4 or 3 life remaining.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without activating Mistwalker's pump ability, dealing only 1 damage with Mistwalker (5 total combat damage).
annotations.betterLine: Activate Mistwalker's ability twice (using 2UU from untapped lands) to make it 3/2, dealing 7 total combat damage and putting opponent to 3 life instead of 5. This is essentially free damage since opponent has no untapped mana for tricks and Mistwalker faces no blockers.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 10 life with all creatures and lands tapped (no blockers, no combat tricks possible). Mistwalker is attacking unblocked as a 1/4. Gem3F has 3 untapped lands and could activate Mistwalker's +1/-1 ability at least once to deal extra combat damage with zero risk.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without activating Mistwalker's pump ability, dealing only 1 damage with it instead of 2-3.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Mistwalker's {1}{U}: +1/-1 ability once or twice to deal 2-3 extra combat damage. With opponent completely tapped out, there's no risk to reducing toughness. Even one activation (costing 1U) would deal an extra point of damage for free.

annotations.description: Blocking Staunch Shieldmate (1/3) and Trusty Retriever (3/4) with the two Merfolk tokens prevents 4 damage (taking 7, going to 7 life). Double-blocking Basri's Lieutenant (6/7) with both tokens would prevent 6 damage (taking 5, going to 9 life), saving 2 additional life points. Both tokens die either way, so the double-block on the biggest threat is strictly better for life total preservation.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Staunch Shieldmate and Trusty Retriever with the two Merfolk tokens, preventing 4 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Double-block Basri's Lieutenant with both Merfolk tokens to prevent 6 damage instead of 4, going to 9 life instead of 7.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 5 life with no flyers or reach creatures. Mistwalker (1/4 flying) could attack for guaranteed 1 damage with zero risk. Even better, Gem3F has Heirloom Blade on the battlefield and 3 untapped Islands - they could equip Heirloom Blade (Equip {1}) to Mistwalker for 1 mana, making it a 4/5 flyer dealing 4 damage to bring opponent to 1 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Did not attack with Mistwalker
annotations.betterLine: Equip Heirloom Blade to Mistwalker (1 mana), then attack with Mistwalker as a 4/5 flyer for 4 unblockable damage, putting opponent to 1 life. At minimum, attack with the unequipped Mistwalker for 1 free damage.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 5 life and Mistwalker is likely attacking with flying (opponent has no flyers and most creatures are tapped). Activating Mistwalker's +1/-1 ability once would pump it to 2/3, dealing an extra point of combat damage. With 3 untapped Islands, the cost of {1}{U} is easily affordable while still leaving 1 Island up. Every point of damage matters at 5 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Mistwalker's pump ability during combat.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Mistwalker's {1}{U}: +1/-1 ability at least once to deal 2 damage instead of 1, bringing the opponent closer to lethal range.

annotations.description: GLM47 missed lethal. Casting Basri's Solidarity (all creatures get +1/+1) followed by Feat of Resistance on Basri's Lieutenant (another +1/+1 and protection from blue) would make the Lieutenant an 8/9 that can't be blocked by Mistwalker. The remaining creatures would deal enough additional damage to exceed 10 life total, delivering lethal this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Siege Striker (summoning sick, can't attack this turn), missing the lethal line.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Basri's Solidarity ({1}{W}) to pump all creatures, then Feat of Resistance ({1}{W}) on Basri's Lieutenant choosing protection from blue. Lieutenant becomes 8/9 unblockable, attack with all for lethal damage (14+ damage vs 10 life).

annotations.description: With only Mistwalker available to block (other creatures have summoning sickness), attacking with all available creatures would deal at minimum 8 damage (15 minus blocking the 7/8), putting opponent to 2 HP. The vigilant Basri's Lieutenant stays untapped for defense regardless. Instead, attacking with just two creatures means at best 7 damage through (opponent at 3), and at worst 4 damage (opponent at 6).
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only Basri's Lieutenant and Trusty Retriever (11 total power, max 7 through blocks)
annotations.betterLine: Attack with all four available creatures (Basri's Lieutenant, Trusty Retriever, Staunch Shieldmate, Tempered Veteran) for 15 total power. With only Mistwalker to block, minimum 8 damage gets through, putting opponent to 2 HP and virtually guaranteeing the win next turn.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 5 life and Mistwalker can attack unblocked with flying. With 2 untapped Islands and no other use for the mana (Soul Read costs 4), activating Mistwalker's +1/-1 ability once or twice before combat would deal 2-3 damage instead of 1, significantly pressuring the opponent's life total in a race situation.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Mistwalker's pump ability
annotations.betterLine: Activate Mistwalker's +1/-1 ability once or twice (making it 2/3 or 3/2) before moving to combat to maximize flying damage against an opponent at 5 life

annotations.description: At 6 life, the chosen blocks leave Trusty Retriever (4 power) and Staunch Shieldmate (2 power) unblocked for exactly 6 lethal damage. By blocking Trusty Retriever with Bloodline Pretender instead of Siege Striker, only Staunch Shieldmate and Tempered Veteran would be unblocked for 4 total damage, allowing survival at 2 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Blocked Siege Striker with Bloodline Pretender, Tempered Veteran with Amoeboid Changeling, and Basri's Lieutenant with Sage of the Falls — leaving Trusty Retriever (4 power) and Staunch Shieldmate (2 power) unblocked for 6 lethal damage.
annotations.betterLine: Block Basri's Lieutenant with Sage of the Falls, Trusty Retriever with Bloodline Pretender, and Siege Striker with Amoeboid Changeling. This leaves only Staunch Shieldmate (2) and Tempered Veteran (2) unblocked for 4 damage, surviving at 2 life.

annotations.description: With the opponent at 2 life, putting the +1/+1 counter on Staunch Shieldmate (a defensive creature) is suboptimal. Siege Striker with double strike would benefit far more from the counter, becoming a 3/3 double striker that can also tap creatures to grow when attacking, maximizing the ability to push through lethal damage.
annotations.actionTaken: Put +1/+1 counter on Staunch Shieldmate
annotations.betterLine: Put +1/+1 counter on Siege Striker, making it a 3/3 double striker that threatens 6+ damage and maximizes lethal potential against an opponent at 2 life

annotations.description: Chose protection from white on Staunch Shieldmate when the opponent is mono-blue. Protection from blue would shield it from any potential blue instant-speed interaction for the remainder of the turn, while protection from white does literally nothing in this matchup.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose White for Feat of Resistance's protection color
annotations.betterLine: Choose Blue for Feat of Resistance's protection, as the opponent is playing blue and has untapped Islands that could cast blue instants in response or during the end step.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 2 life with no untapped creatures that can block (River Sneak is summoning sick). GLM47 has multiple large creatures including an 8/9 Basri's Lieutenant with vigilance. Any single attacker would deal lethal damage. This is a missed lethal.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to declare any attackers, passing the combat phase.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with all creatures (or even just Basri's Lieutenant alone) to deal lethal damage to the opponent at 2 life with no blockers available.
